bio: Scott Bourke (spelled Bourke on site and footer image; sheet has Brouke) is a Red Deer, Alberta mortgage broker with 20+ years' experience and access to 68+ lenders. His site offers purchase, refinance, new build, HELOC and purchase-plus-improvements, with a strong private-lender and refinance angle. He combines mortgage brokering with real estate expertise and has chaired or co-chaired four Red Deer Kinsmen Dream Homes.
